decisions.reason: Sweet pastry is close to the core assortment and no negative results were reported, so it appears to meet the aspiration level and can be carried with existing slack.

Crusty farmhouse bread is close to established bread lines and no shortfall is reported, but with less evidence it remains somewhat uncertain, so the firm keeps it while monitoring against aspiration.
Poppy seed Christmas stollen is a flagship with a Gold award, clearly exceeding the aspiration level, so it is very unlikely to be dropped and supports the firm's direction.
Premium Christmas stollen has a Gold award and is close to the established seasonal range, so it meets or exceeds aspirations and is retained.
